info.title: WHOIS History API: Historical WHOIS Records Since 1986
info.description: Retrieve the full chronological history of WHOIS registration records for a domain name, going back to 1986 where available. Each record in the returned array is a snapshot capturing the registrar, registrant/admin/technical/billing contacts, name servers, domain status codes, and both the original and registry-level raw WHOIS text as they existed at that point in time. Pass `domainName` as a bare domain (e.g. `example.com`); a `https://` or `http://` prefix is also accepted. Early historical snapshots may include only a subset of fields (e.g. dates without registrar or name server data) since registries did not always publish complete records; a domain with no historical WHOIS data returns a `404` error.

get.summary: Retrieve the complete historical WHOIS record timeline for a domain name
get.description: Returns every recorded WHOIS snapshot for the specified domain in chronological order, including registrar, contact, name server, and status changes over time.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: Domain name to retrieve historical WHOIS records for (e.g. example.com).

DomainWhoisHistoryLookupResponse.description: Chronological collection of historical WHOIS snapshots for the requested domain.

status.description: true if the request was successfully processed.

whois.description: Indicates that this response contains historical WHOIS data.

total_records.description: Total number of historical records found for the queried domain.

whois_domains_historical.description: Historical WHOIS snapshots for the domain, in chronological order.

DomainWhoisHistoryRecord.description: A single historical WHOIS snapshot captured at a point in time. Early snapshots may omit fields the registry did not publish at that time.

num.description: 1-based sequence number of this record within the historical timeline.

status.description: Always true for a returned historical record.

domain_name.description: Domain name this snapshot was recorded for.

query_time.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot was captured.

whois_server.description: WHOIS server that provided this snapshot's domain-level data, when recorded.

domain_registered.description: Domain registration status at the time of this snapshot, when recorded.

create_date.description: Date the domain was originally registered, as known at the time of this snapshot.

update_date.description: Date the domain registration was last updated, as of this snapshot.

expiry_date.description: Date the domain registration was set to expire, as of this snapshot.

domain_registrar.description: Registrar of record for the domain as of this snapshot.

reseller_contact.description: Reseller contact details, when the domain was registered through a reseller, as published in this snapshot.

registrant_contact.description: Domain registrant (owner) contact details as published in this snapshot.

administrative_contact.description: Administrative contact details as published in this snapshot.

technical_contact.description: Technical contact details as published in this snapshot.

billing_contact.description: Billing contact details as published in this snapshot.

name_servers.description: Name servers recorded for the domain as of this snapshot.

domain_status.description: EPP domain status codes recorded as of this snapshot.

whois_raw_domain.description: Raw WHOIS text for the domain as of this snapshot.

DomainRegistrar.description: Registrar of record at the time of the snapshot.

whois_server.description: WHOIS server operated by the registrar, when published.

email_address.description: Registrar abuse or contact email address, when published.

phone_number.description: Registrar contact phone number, when published.

WhoisContactDetail.description: A contact record (registrant, administrative, technical, billing, or reseller) as published in this snapshot.

email_address.description: Contact email address, or a privacy-service redirect instruction.

mailing_address.description: Full combined mailing address, when published as a single string.

DomainWhoisHistoryRegistryData.description: Registry-level (as opposed to registrar-level) WHOIS data for this snapshot, sourced directly from the TLD registry.

domain_name.description: Domain name as recorded by the registry.

query_time.description: Timestamp when the registry-level record was queried.

whois_server.description: Registry WHOIS server that returned this data.

domain_registered.description: Domain registration status as recorded by the registry.

create_date.description: Domain creation date as recorded by the registry.

update_date.description: Domain last-updated date as recorded by the registry.

expiry_date.description: Domain expiry date as recorded by the registry.

name_servers.description: Name servers as recorded by the registry.

domain_status.description: EPP domain status codes as recorded by the registry.

whois_raw_registery.description: Raw WHOIS text as returned directly by the registry server.

domain_registrar.description: Registrar of record as recorded directly by the registry.
